name: probe-sskr-threshold-cli
command: for tc in '1 3' '2 17' '3 2' '2 2' '16 16' '0 3' '2 1.5'; do set -- $tc; echo "--- threshold $1 shares $2"; node dist/mnemocode.js encode --sskr --threshold $1 --shares $2 --mnemonic 'abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon about' --output /tmp/mnemocode-aud-002-QuXG/t-$1-$2.txt >/dev/null; echo exit=$?; done; wc -l /tmp/mnemocode-aud-002-QuXG/t-2-2.txt /tmp/mnemocode-aud-002-QuXG/t-16-16.txt
